blocks.text: WASHINGTON — Amen Thompson scored 26 points and Kevin Durant added 25 to help the Houston Rockets rout the Washington Wizards 147-119 on Sunday night for their fourth straight win. The Rockets also held Trae Young scoreless for the first time in his NBA career. He missed all five of his shots and had previous scored in all 511 of his prior career games with the Hawks and Wizards.
